Implementation Notes

The input is a criteria payload in JSON format. Only required filter criteria fields can be provided to get the desired project records. 
***
**Response includes:**        
* Total Count of matches       
* Offset  
* Limit
* Total number of pages (based on the Limit per request)
* One or more matching projects. 
***
**Example input payloads:** 
***

        
**Complete Payload with Partially Filled Properties:**


The following is a partially filled input Payload. The "include_fields" values are used to return only specified columns. 

        {
         "criteria": {
           "use_relevance": true,
           "fiscal_years": [],
           "include_active_projects": true,
           "pi_names": [
             {
               "any_name": "",
               "first_name": "",
               "last_name": ""
             }
           ],
           "po_names": [
             {
               "any_name": "",
               "first_name": "",
               "last_name": ""
             }
           ],
           "org_names": [
                         "EMORY UNIVERSITY",
                         "JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY",
                         "NEW ECHOTA BIOTECHNOLOGY, INC.",
                         "UNIV OF NORTH CAROLINA CHAPEL HILL",
                         "UNIV OF NORTH CAROLINA CHAPEL HILL"
           ],
           "pi_profile_ids": [
             0,1
           ],
           "org_cities": [
             ""
           ],
           "org_states": [
             ""
           ],
           "project_nums": [],
           "org_countries": [
             "UNITED STATES"
           ],
           "appl_ids": [],
           "project_num_split": {
             "appl_type_code": "",
             "activity_code": "",
             "ic_code": "",
             "serial_num": "",
             "support_year": "",
             "suffix_code": ""
           },
           "agencies": [
             ""
           ],
           "is_agency_admin": true,
           "is_agency_funding": true,
           "activity_codes": [
             ""
           ],
           "award_types": [
             ""
           ],
           "dept_types": [
             ""
           ],
           "cong_dists": [
             ""
           ],
           "opportunity_numbers": [
             ""
           ],
           "spending_categories": {
             "values": [
               0
             ],
             "match_all": true
           },
           "project_start_date": {
             "from_date": "",
             "to_date": ""
           },
           "project_end_date": {
             "from_date": "",
             "to_date": ""
           },
           "organization_type": [
             ""
           ],
           "full_study_sections": [
             {
               "irg_code": "",
               "sra_designator_code": "",
               "sra_flex_code": "",
               "group_code": "",
               "name": "",
               "url": ""
             }
           ],
           "award_notice_date": {
               "from_date": "2020-02-17",
               "to_date": "2021-05-01"
           },
           "award_amount_range": {
               "min_amount": 0,
               "max_amount": 50000000
           },
           "date_added": {
               "from_date": "2020-02-17",
               "to_date": "2021-05-01"
           },
           "exclude_subprojects": false,
           "multi_pi_only": false,
           "newly_added_projects_only": false,
           "sub_project_only": false,
           "funding_mechanism": [
             ""
           ],
           "covid_response" : [
             ""
           ]
         },
         "include_fields": [
           "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum",
           "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
           "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
         ],
         "exclude_fields": [
           ""
         ],
         "offset": 0,
         "limit": 0,
         "sort_field": "",
         "sort_order": ""
     }        
        
**Opportunity Number Search:**

 The Following criteria payload filters the projects by given Opportunity Number list and returns 10 records sorted by Application ID in descending order.
   
     {
        "criteria": {
            "opportunity_numbers": [
                "RFA-DA-18-020",
                "PAR-18-218",
                "PAR-18-219",
                "RFA-DA-19-002",
                "RFA-DA-19-019",
                "RFA-DA-19-020",
                "RFA-EB-18-003",
                "RFA-NS-18-041",
                "RFA-NS-18-042",
                "RFA-NS-18-043",
                "RFA-NS-18-046",
                "RFA-NS-19-010",
                "RFA-NS-19-016",
                "RFA-NS-19-017",
                "RFA-NS-19-018",
                "RFA-NS-19-020",
                "RFA-NS-19-036"
            ]
        },
        "include_fields": [
            "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum",
            "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
            "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate","OpportunityNumber"    
        ],
        "offset": 10,
        "limit": 10,
        "sort_field": "appl_id",
        "sort_order": "desc"
     }
 



 **Org Name Search:**

 The Following criteria payload filters the projects by given Organization Name list and returns 25 records sorted by Project Start Date in descending order.
 
      {
            "criteria":
            {
                "org_names": ["HARVARD MEDICAL SCHOOL"]
            },
            "include_fields": [
                 "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum",
                 "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
                 "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
             ],
             "offset":0,
             "limit":25,
             "sort_field":"project_start_date",
              "sort_order":"desc"
       }
  



**Project Number Search With Wildcard:**

 The wildcard helps to search the projects with partial Project Numbers. The "*" is used to match zero or more characters. It is recommended not to use the Wildcard at the beginning of the text to avoid the lengthy process.
   
     {
         "criteria":
         {
            "project_nums": ["1r03ai1*"]
         },
         "include_fields": [
             "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum",
             "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
             "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
         ],
         "offset":0,
         "limit":25,
         "sort_field":"project_start_date",
         "sort_order":"desc"
     }




**Fiscal Year or Institute Search:**

 You can specify the list of Fiscal Years to filter the associated projects. 
  
     {
         "criteria":
         {
           "fiscal_years":[2019,2018]
         },
         "include_fields": [
            "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum","OrgCountry",
            "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
            "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
         ],
         "offset":0,
         "limit":25,
         "sort_field":"project_start_date",
         "sort_order":"desc"
     }
      


**Specify the list of Agencies to filter the corresponding projects:**

     {
        "criteria":
        {
            "agencies":["NIGMS","NIAID"]
        },
        "include_fields": [
            "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum","OrgCountry",
            "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
            "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
        ],
        "offset":0,
        "limit":25,
        "sort_field":"project_start_date",
        "sort_order":"desc"
     }
  



**Opportunity Number with PI Elements with No Submitted Value Search:**

 The following criteria filter will search all projects with given Funding Opportunity Announcements and Principle Investigators for all Fiscal Years. 
  
       {
          "criteria":
           {
               "fiscal_years":[],
               "pi_names": [{"any_name": ""},{"first_name": ""} ],
               "opportunity_numbers":["RFA-DA-18-020","PAR-18-218","PAR-18-219"]
           },
           "include_fields": [
               "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum","OrgCountry",
               "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
               "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate","OpportunityNumber"
           ],
           "offset":0,
           "limit":25,
           "sort_field":"project_start_date",
           "sort_order":"desc"
       }
  



**Multiple Investigators (OR) Search:**

 Multiple parameters for Principle Investigator can be specified e.g. First, Last or any name. The projects with any matching parameters return by the API. 
 
      {
         "criteria":
         {
             "fiscal_years":[],
             "pi_names": [{"any_name": "gullo"},{"first_name": ""},{"any_name": "welch"},{"first_name": ""}]
         },
         "include_fields": [
             "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum","OrgCountry",
             "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
             "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
         ],
         "offset":0,
         "limit":10
     }


***



**NIH COVID-19 Response Search:**

     {
         "criteria":
         {
            "covid_response": ["Reg-CV", "CV"]
         },
         "include_fields": [
                "ApplId","SubprojectId","FiscalYear","Organization", "ProjectNum","OrgCountry",
                "ProjectNumSplit","ContactPiName","AllText","FullStudySection",
                "ProjectStartDate","ProjectEndDate"
         ],
         "offset":0,
         "limit":10
     }

***


**The response can be in JSON and is controlled by the 'Accept' request header.**

excludeFields.description:
Exclude these fields in the results.
If null or empty, no fields are excluded.

includeFields.description:
Include these fields in the results.
If null the all fields are included by default.
If not null but empty, then no fields are included.

limit.description: Number of records to retrieve. System imposed limit is 50

sortField.description: Name of the property to sort on

post.summary: Retrieves Projects against specified criteria payload.

Implementation Notes

The input is a criteria payload in JSON format. Only required filter criteria fields can be provided to get the desired publication records. 
***
**Response includes:**        
* Total Count of matches       
* Offset  
* Limit
* Total number of pages (based on the Limit per request)
* One or more matching publications. 
***
**Example input payloads:** 
***

        
**Complete Payload with all Filled Properties:**


The following is a partially filled input Payload.

        {
         "criteria": {
           "appl_ids": [
               10125113,
               9931223,
               10102270
           ],
           "pmids": [
               33205613,
               33858821,
               33288912
           ],
           "core_project_nums": [
               "T32GM062754",
               "U01HL136297",
               "F31HL149358"
           ]
         },
         "offset": 0,
         "limit": 10,
         "sort_field":"core_project_nums",
         "sort_order":"asc"
     }        
        
**PMID Search:**

 The following criteria payload filters the publications by the given PMID list and returns 10 records sorted by Core Project Num in descending order.
   
     {
        "criteria": {
            "pmids": [
                33205613,
                33858821,
                33288912
            ]
        },
        "offset": 0,
        "limit": 10, 
        "sort_field":"pmids",
        "sort_order":"desc"
     }
 

***

 **Application ID Search:**

 The following criteria payload filters the publications by the given application ids and returns 10 records sorted by Core Project Num in descending order.
   
     {
        "criteria": {
            "appl_ids": [
                9507800, 
                8986571
            ]
        },
        "offset": 0,
        "limit": 10,
        "sort_field":"appl_ids",
        "sort_order":"desc"
     }
 

***

**Core Project Number Search:**

 The following criteria payload filters the publications by the given Core Project Number list and returns 10 records sorted by Core Project Num in descending order.
   
     {
        "criteria": {
            "core_project_nums": [
                "T32DA023356",
                "K01DA040543"
            ]
        },
        "offset": 0,
        "limit": 10,
        "sort_field":"core_project_nums",
        "sort_order":"desc"
     }
 

***

**The response can be in JSON and is controlled by the 'Accept' request header.**

criteria.description: DTO - Used to support external client requests

limit.description: Number of records to retrieve. System imposed limit is 50

sortField.description: Name of the property to sort on
